name: Lokimo
positioning: La puissance des données au service des professionnels de l'immobilier.
description: Lokimo is a French property-intelligence platform for real estate professionals that aggregates roughly 130 public and proprietary data sources — transactions, listings, press, INSEE, Etalab — around a chosen address, parcel or zone. It scores the area on attractiveness, risk (flooding, pollution, noise) and demographic trends, and generates ready-to-present analysis reports.
real_estate_use: An asset manager or developer scouting a parcel selects the zone on Lokimo instead of manually cross-referencing transaction, demographic and risk databases, and gets an area score covering economic activity, gentrification trends and flood, pollution or noise risk. Before a project committee, they filter parcels by criteria and export a formatted report in two clicks rather than compiling one by hand, cutting the time spent qualifying a site before deciding whether to pursue it.
features: Aggregation of about 130 real estate and public data sources
Zone scoring on attractiveness, risk and demographic trend
Parcel filtering by commercial potential criteria
Multi-scale analysis from parcel to municipality

use_cases.job: Qualify a zone's attractiveness and risk profile before committing to a project
Filter parcels by potential and export a report for a project committee
